This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species was distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|green]] skin.<ref name="SotE" /> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> several members of this species worked as [[Security guard/Legends|armed enforcers]] within the [[Scraplands/Legends|Scraplands]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where they eventually encountered the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] during his [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Dash Rendar)|attempt to locate]] the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[IG-88D/Legends|IG-88]].<ref name="SotE" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the<ref name="SotE" /> [[1996]]<ref name="Nintendo Life">{{WebCite|url=http://www.nintendolife.com/games/n64/star_wars_shadows_of_the_empire|text=Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (N64 / Nintendo 64) News, Reviews, Trailer & Screenshots|work=Nintendo Life|archivedate=20200527051744}}</ref> video game [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]]. In game, when killed, members this species would produce a sound<ref name="SotE" /> similar to the screams of a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
